'''Derrend Montis''' was a wealthy [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]]. He obtained a [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]], which he named [[New Ambition|''Shadowfire'']], that he modified to increase the craft's combat capabilities. Following his [[Death/Legends|death]], ownership of the ''Shadowfire'' passed to a shipping company.
